cohort: Nulliparous non-diabetic women with singleton, vertex LGA (>90th centile) births in Sweden from 1992-2013
finding: Induction of labor at 38 weeks gestation in women with suspected large-for-gestational-age (LGA) fetuses was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery compared to expectant management, with no difference in neonatal morbidity.
mod_finding: We found that among the 722 women induced at week 38, there was a significantly increased risk of cesarean delivery (aOR = 1.44 95% CI:1.20-1.72), compared to those with expectant management (n = 44 081).
